job_spec.structural_change: Third structure of ot_hdc_vstream_lane_t at ML15 (ml15 / ml15r2 stopped: bench configuration, then FLOORPLAN_MARGIN 51,612 sinks on one root): the lane tile is split into four hardened leaves with their own clock roots (routed-netlist flops: head 11,844, exp 9,861, rsqrt 9,688, recip 6,819); the 16.1k-flop B/C/tail tapped line is one 1R1W SRAM ring (ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2, cycle-exact) in the head; each SFU pipeline is a leaf with pin flops in and out, the head launches and captures at its pins (SFU classes +4 edges, sigmoid +8); ot_hdc_vstream_lane_t itself is wires only. Lane head ot_hdc_vstream_lane_h (11,844 flops + 1 SRAM): the tile's pin flops, address cycle, ML tag line, 4 multipliers + adder, write; tapped line in the SRAM ring.
